content: Anina ma Moses mai Israel maiteni wei voepaepa welana i ravi Bada awarina:

content.text: Tau ana wela Bada awarina ma ana voepaepai, aubaina ana ḡavia i vipupui,
ma horse ma chariot taugeruii au boga i viorerena-naiei,
Bada au rewapana ḡaeḡaena,
ma welei ana voepaepai;
Tauna i vilawaniu Tauna au God ma ana voepaepai,
Amamau ai God ma lamna aubaina ana vimae-ḡaeḡaeni ma ana voepaepai.
Tauna wavana Bada.
Tauna ḡavia ravana.
Pharaoh ana chariot ma ana sorodia au boga i viorereni;
Ana sorodia vinevinei au Boga Lebalebarina i monui.
Gabinou i wanaiwaḡi da taui i purui;
ma i monu boga au gabaurina me ḡaima.
Oo Bada ura-oiem vivirewapana kaukauana,
ura-oiem am ḡavia e viviaimutumutui.
Tam ḡeḡetelaram
ma taui i viḡaviem u vovaiubai.
Am meji araratana u paritawanei
da taui i aragibui me ai ragorago.
Boga au tepana u uvena ma boga olana i mairi,
i mairi genuatau me biribiri,
ma gabinou i alala.
Am ḡavia i riwa, “Ana viaḡaḡei,
ana vojijini,
ai purapura ma ai maura anatapui ana ḡutai,
ma aiwai a ḡoeḡoei ana vaia,
Au sod ana lavui ma ana vipupui.”
Wate lavutumei u uvena,
ma gabinou taui i purui;
i monu me ḡaima rabama au ḡaeḡaena.
Bada, mepa god ḡelaui me tam bo eḡa? Eḡateni!
Tam anina vivivirem,
am rewapana i rata dewadewa da tauai a rovorovoem,
Tam kaua babai ma virewapanai taukaueina.
Tam uraoiem u viloloi,
ma doa am ḡavia i lawani.
Am rava u vaimelei ma u rauetaraveni am nuavaina patupatutunei,
Ma am rewapanei u taravaina-naiei am au animae vivivireina.
Dobu ḡelaui wei riwana i nonori ma orai i sisi kaua.
Mai Philistia orai rovo ina vioai.
Edom gulagulaui ina rovo kaukaua,
Moab nelara rewapana ini ina sisi.
Canaan maemaei anatapui inii i wanagwadai.
Rovo ḡaeḡaena anatapui orai i oai,
uram ana rewapanei taui i mairi kwakwa me kokoitau,
ma am rava ina verautua Bada,
da ravai u vaivai-melei ina verautua.
Bada ma taravaina da am au ola ina raunuma,
Gabu u vinevineiana,
tam uramei voavoaina.
Bada ina vibada nonoa.

content: Mai Israel doa au alalana i babara damana. Wate maranai mai Egypt ai horse ma ai chariot taugerui i rui au boga, Bada waira i neiana-meleiai da anatapui i purui Lamna aubaina Moses ana rava maiteni wei welana i ravi.
Peroveta Miriam, Aaron novuna tambourine i vaia ma waivine anatapui, tauna i votaḡotaḡoi ma tambourine i vikalokaloei ma i ara.
Miriam wei welana i ravi, “Tana raua Bada awarina, aubaina tauna ḡavia i vilamolamonei ma horse ma chariot taugerui au boga i viorereni.”
Anina ma Moses mai Israel i taravaini da Boga lebalebarina i netawanei ma i nae au Shur mutuluana. Aupom tonuḡa au mutulua i babara wate waira eḡa ita nelaḡai.
Maranai au waira vuvura Marah i ḡeta da ita uma wate wairana umana i viḡora da eḡa ita uma, lamna aubaina wei dobu wavana Marah.
Ma rava Moses awarina i pariḡai i pa, “Aiwai tana umai?”

Anina ma Moses i paritou bada awarina agu aubaina, ma Bada ai tupona i viatataiei. Ma wei aina i tawanei au waira ma waira i viaini aniuma aubaina. Nai au gabuna Bada ana tarawatu rava i verei ai lawana aubaina, ma ai votelatela i raudadani.
Bada i riwa, “Mepa da riwau ona nonora-kauei ma kaua aiaii ona kauei au matau ma riwau anatapuna ona voteletelei, da kovoḡa mai Egypt a vereverei, eḡa ana veremi. Tau Bada tauvilawanimi.”
Muriai taui i nei au Elim kampa vuvura 12 ma mutulua ai me pa 70 i maimairi ma kampa waira au adana i mae mara aburuna.

footnotes.text: Au Hebrew pona Maranonorana me viḡora.
